text: [Trip Report]: My first bad trip Hi everyone!**Intro**: I had my first bad trip recently and I must say it was quite educational, not about myself but about about LSD and about bad trips/how to avoid them. Since this was my only one so far I wouldn't (yet) consider myself an expert. Just as there are hundreds of  different kinds of trips you can have there probably are equally many types of bad trips. Still - I couldn't really imagine how a bad trip happens from my previous trips (which have been numerous). Maybe this will help some people, especially newbies.**Report**: I recently read that doing sports on LSD is quite amazing. I live right next to a a small forest (the roads through it are a mix of gravel and dirt/leaves so amazing for running too) which would not only be a beautiful setting but also remote enough to not meet anyone who could get suspicious. My first mistake was assuming that since I'm very well versed with 300+µg and often bored by 150µg  I would be completely fine doing something new on the same dose so I dropped two tabs instead of one (I seem to have somewhat of a high natural tolerance, must be a very stable brain chemistry or something, I don't know - My last trip was a 360µg LSD + 150mg MDMA and I was just fine with that).The evening before I did however ask a few more people on their opinions, if going running while tripping would be a good idea. However those were people who were not informed about it (hadn't tried it) so they weren't sure about it, someone even outright saying it would be a bad idea (probably assuming I was going for a run in a deep forest, without roads or something - I wouldn't have been further from my house than 2km at any point, no further from the nearest actual street than  200-300m. Worst risk would have been falling and breaking my ankle or something which I wasn't expecting because LSD doesn't really affect balance, at least not for me. This did however plant the first seed of doubt in my head.This doubt, when I was actually tripping the next morning quickly turned into confusion. I forgot pretty much everything that I know about LSD and started mistaking it for MDMA: I was thinking about my heart, about overheating, dehydrating and generally being worried so I was very torn if I should go for a while. I ended up in the tripsit #drugs channel simply because I was confused and unable to finish my thought (which should have been: "Doing this worries me, I should do it another time and just do my usual stuff"). If I had just gone played _PERSON_ or something at this point I would have been perfectly fine. I did however stay in the drugs channel, unable to clearly express what I wanted to people started assuming I was having a bad trip. The sheer fact that they were believing I had a bad trip is probably what was the final nail in the coffin: They started talking me down but I was starting to wonder why the fuck I was having a bad trip. I have been having some emotional trouble (depression) lately, which doesn't usually flow into my trips (quite the opposite - LSD always breaks me out of my depressed perspective and helps me see myself in a different light, which helps me when I'm sober). The thought that I would be tripping depressed probably scared me so much that I ended up having a complete panic attack (I was also still confused. I believe at some point I thought my live as I knew it was going to end now, that I wouldnt be able to contain myself in my room and everyone would know that I was tripping. I kept apologising to my parents, to the people in tripsit who "had to deal with me", to the people that I was sure were already coming to find me (I thought the trip-sit people thought that I was dying or going to harm myself which means they could be trying to find out where I live thorugh my IP to send the police to my house). I believe I also tried to apologize to the Jews (I'm a German) but I think I apologized to the Nazis by accident, what for I don't know.Anyways, at this point I had to kill my trip with xanax, the panic was getting too much. Sadly I had gotten up very early (so I wouldnt meet other joggers or at least not as many) so calling a friend / talking to my room mate who like LSD too). 15 minutes later I was completely sober while still having massive visuals and thought: "_PERSON_, I just killed my trip, why the fuck did I do that". **Closing words**: _PERSON_ from my mistakes. When tripping alone at least know how to operate tripsit. A big part of why tripsit didn't really help me was that I went to the #drugs channel when I should have been in #sanctuary or #tripsit . Also I recommend writing a letter to yourself for bad trips that you have ready before the tripping starts ([Inspiration for that](_URL_ I have read about stopping bad trips a hundred times (changing the setting, etc) yet in that very moment I did not remember any of it. Anyways, if anything this has made me want to do LSD more and more often (although only 1 tab, when I'm trying something new).
